Subject: EB briefing slotting & sponsor rotation proposal

Jordan —

Great conversation today. Per our call I attached a working mutual action plan (Alpha_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short exec-sponsor roster template. Two asks to help us lock the EB (executive briefing) and close timeline:

1) Confirm which C-suite sponsor(s) you want to seat in the EB: we suggested CIO and VP of Data Ops on the call. If you have a different preference, list names/titles and a preferred backup.

2) Pick two candidate EB windows in the next two weeks (90-minute slots). We typically run a 60–75 minute session (customer execs + product/solutions + short demo + next steps) and recommend 2 internal Redwood attendees: one executive (Marissa or Laura) + solutions lead (Ben).

Attached: Alpha_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP draft with milestones), Exec_Sponsor_Roster.csv (simple table to fill), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (for procurement readiness).

If youd like, I can circulate a proposed run-of-show once you confirm sponsors and a preferred slot.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing the MAP and aligning evaluation milestones to the EB.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales, North America
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: Alpha_MAP_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Exec_Sponsor_Roster.csv (csv), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)
